{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:00.000

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:06.000

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:10.000
    | text      = I've played them many times throughout my life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:14.000
    | text      = I'm still enjoying throwing those little guys around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:16.000
    | text      = There are just some games like that where it is, for whatever reason,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:21.000
    | text      = like the time in your life when it hits you, or just like this gameplay loop,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:25.000
    | text      = the tactile feel of it just hits my brain right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:28.000
    | text      = Yeah. I think there's just a lot of charm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:31.000
    | text      = It looks so good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:33.000
    | text      = Everything is cartoony and pleasant, and most of it is like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:38.000
    | text      = you're running around little gardens or whatever trying to pick up bottle caps and shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:42.000
    | text      = It's just fun and calming in the same way that a lot of people found Animal Crossing calming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:50.000
    | text      = And then those little guys, they're fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:54.000
    | text      = I mean, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:55.000

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:56.000
    | text      = No argument. It's fun to throw little guys.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:59.000
    | text      = And I think, you know, this sucks, but I do feel like the villains in the game have it coming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:05.000
    | text      = I feel bad that there's combat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:07.000

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:09.000
    | text      = But those big guys, they're going to eat your little guys at night if you don't kill them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:14.000
    | text      = I mean, to a certain extent, narratively, every villain has to be deserving of their comeuppance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:24.000
    | text      = Regardless of whether or not we would say so outside, the narrative has to drive towards them,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:30.000
    | text      = receiving an equal...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:34.000
    | text      = Yeah. I would argue that in a lot of narrative-driven stuff, the villain has a good point, though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:41.000
    | text      = Oftentimes they're misunderstood or they're like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:44.000
    | text      = hey, they're right, but they're going about things in the wrong way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:47.000
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:48.000
    | text      = These villains in Pikmin, nah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:50.000
    | text      = You know what undercut Black Panther?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:53.000
    | text      = Because I think Michael B. Jordan's character does have a lot of really good points,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:57.000
    | text      = but it's tough when your name is Killmonger to be the good guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:01.000
    | text      = You don't name yourself Killmonger if you're the good guy, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:08.000
    | text      = You don't come around on Killmonger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:10.000
    | text      = No, no, no, no, no. You're trying to send a message.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:13.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:14.000
    | text      = I mean, there's a villain named Apocalypse, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:18.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:19.000
    | text      = Like, that guy's not going to be... He's not chill.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:22.000
    | text      = Yeah. Now, on the other hand, if the villain names himself just like Terry Jones,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:27.000
    | text      = you're like, I mean, it seems like he could be a normal guy eventually.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:30.000
    | text      = Uh-huh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:31.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:32.000
    | text      = Or like your name as a supervillain is, we've got to deal with the problems.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:38.000
    | text      = Then it's like, well, yeah, you know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:41.000
    | text      = My welcome to systemic issues, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:45.000
    | text      = I could hang with that quicker than Killmonger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:48.000
    | text      = Yeah, Killmonger is real. I think you just write yourself into the corner once you name a character.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:53.000

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:55.000
    | text      = Yeah. Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = So the presidency itself is turning into a diversion, a distraction.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:49.000
    | text      = You can forget seizing control of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:51.000
    | text      = You got to start at the lower level first.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:54.000
    | text      = And no, I don't plan to ever run for political office.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:57.000
    | text      = Um, we're way past that point trying to get control of committee chairmanships and trying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:03.000
    | text      = to get control of the presidency.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:05.000
    | text      = It's going to happen at the state level if it happens at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:07.000
    | text      = I think that tells you everything you need to know about the shift Alex made in the recent
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:11.000
    | text      = years.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:12.000
    | text      = Previous to being recruited by Roger Stone, Alex didn't believe that it was possible to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:17.000
    | text      = seize power on the national level.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:19.000
    | text      = He knew that the ideas he pushed were things that he could usually make sound decent in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:24.000
    | text      = long-winded meandering rants, but when it was time to put them into law, no one would
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:29.000
    | text      = be interested.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:30.000
    | text      = It's awesome to yell about freedom and how the man can't hold back the human spirit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:35.000
    | text      = But when you realize that what's behind that is a law making it so employers are free from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:39.000
    | text      = responsibility for on the job injuries, your enthusiasm fades just a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:44.000
    | text      = It's a little different.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:45.000
    | text      = Alex likes to act like upholding the constitution is the end all be all of his philosophy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:50.000
    | text      = And part of that is the importance of states rights over the federal government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:54.000
    | text      = But that's an act.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:56.000
    | text      = In the real world, he just recognized that his ideology couldn't compete on the national
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:01.000
    | text      = level, whereas there was a real chance that a very small number of zealots could change
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:05.000
    | text      = a local election.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:07.000
    | text      = His shit was unpopular, but unpopular can work when turnout is low enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:12.000
    | text      = When you hear a clip like this, there's a draw towards thinking, wow, Alex sure has
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:16.000
    | text      = changed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:17.000
    | text      = But I actually think that this is very compatible with his present day ideology.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:21.000
    | text      = It's not about whether the states or the federal government should be in charge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:26.000
    | text      = It's all about power and how it can be taken.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:30.000
    | text      = At some point, Alex was convinced that a top-down seizure of power was possible, whereas
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:35.000
    | text      = before he believed that it could only come bottom up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:39.000
    | text      = He only could take the states and use that to control the federal government or to disempower
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:46.000
    | text      = it to the point where your states could do whatever they wanted.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:49.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:50.000
    | text      = I mean, I think that's such a great, how would I put it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:58.000
    | text      = If you take a look at his words from those different time periods, you see different
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:03.000
    | text      = words, and if you think those different words mean anything, you're absurd.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:08.000
    | text      = But that goal is what changed the words.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:11.000
    | text      = That idea of this is what we do to create something small and then go from something
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:15.000
    | text      = big changed once he thought he could get something big and oppress something small.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:20.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:21.000
    | text      = It's not that the words meant anything in either situation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:25.000
    | text      = It's just that the goal changed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:26.000
    | text      = Well, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:28.000
    | text      = The goal was the same.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:29.000
    | text      = Well, the goal, yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:30.000
    | text      = The tactics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:31.000
    | text      = The goal was always taking power.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:33.000
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:34.000
    | text      = The tactics changed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:35.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:36.000
    | text      = What we thought the means to the goal was or what he was pretending was the way we are
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:34:42.000
    | text      = going to achieve this thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:48.000

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = That was all fake.

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
